payload.answer: Both should be possible. If unspecified, questiontool needs to ask the question.

asked.key: should a benchmark run have a limit on how many questions the model playing the owner answers, or on how many turns or minutes a run may take? if yes, what limit do you want? you said on 21 oct: "there should always be a question owner in my opinion. a model answers the questions of the other one."

options.description: A run stops answering after the number of questions or turns you give, and the questions beyond it are counted as unanswered. Recommended: You asked for one command to measure how much the model can do on its own, and a run with no limit could run indefinitely. A limit you name keeps the cost bounded without guessing a number for you.
options.label: Set a limit you name (Recommended)

options.description: The model playing the owner answers every question the agent asks, and a run is not cut short by a cap.
options.label: No limit
